length_definition.unit: covered length (ns), same definition as L01; prefix = frames 0..(L/0.1) of the 0-1 ns history, 100 ps spacing
length_definition.note: Differs from the G-series naming at 1.0 ns: G145's '1.0 ns' prefix is frames [0..9], while L01/L02's covered 1.0 ns is frames [0..10].

base.name: K06(b) strong base: frozen T1I2006 + HistGBM sidecar (160 iters, lr 0.065, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 20, L2 0.15, seed 20261121), trained on 8 calibration proteins, evaluated on 100 unseen proteins x 3 replicas

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (100 test proteins, resampled with replacement)
bootstrap.note: Within each resample, static-only, full-history, prefix-mean and prefix-stats6 AUPRCs are recomputed and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit; per-candidate predicted probabilities are resampled. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every condition. Macro AUPRC within a resample is the multiplicity-weighted mean of per-protein AUPRCs over proteins whose AUPRC is defined.
